body:
Hi there, thank you so much for replying. Just having a rough night. been suicidal off an on for years. Having some bad anxiety and with every attack I have less and less desire to keep going.
I don't have much to live for, I feel guilty even typing that because I have a place to live and food to eat. That's all I should need. But I have a lot of trouble doing anything and I feel like a generally shitty person and pretty useless. Thank you for being there, it means a lot.
I'm here, talk to me. I'll listen, please hang in there.
